title: Synthetic cloud sign-in with VPN contradiction

provenance.method: Fictional cloud identity and VPN events written for this corpus.

seedEvents.description: Cloud risk engine flagged an impossible-travel sign-in for user-b from 192.0.2.80
Corporate VPN assigned exit address 192.0.2.80 to user-b

findings.confidenceReason: The risky sign-in is real, but the VPN record offers a benign explanation.
findings.title: Suspicious cloud sign-in requires validation
findings.description: The suspicious cloud sign-in conflicts with a corporate VPN assignment and does not confirm takeover.

cannedOutput.summary: The sign-in alert is contradicted by a matching VPN assignment.

nextSteps.action: Review cloud audit logs and device identity for user-b
nextSteps.rationale: Device and post-login activity can distinguish normal VPN use from account misuse.

uncertainties.basis: The risk alert is countered by a corporate VPN record.
uncertainties.gap: Device identity and post-login cloud actions are missing.
